attack_techniques: Hide Artifacts: Hidden Files and Directories (T1564.001)
attackers_goals: Attackers may attempt to dump the memory of sensitive processes.
description: Procdump.exe is a SysInternals tool used to dump process memory; it can be used to dump lsass.exe memory to extract credentials.
investigative_actions: Check whether the executing process is benign and if this was a desired behavior as part of its normal execution flow.
name: Procdump executed from an atypical directory
